abstention: No threshold/metric/arm tuning after the run. Poor replication everywhere is a finding, not a tuning trigger. Negatives preserved in research/negative_results.md.

repro5_EXP-AB-C2B.ablation: arch_b precision_kind='shift_reset', surprise_k=4.0 (ONE variant, k frozen).
repro5_EXP-AB-C2B.baseline: arch_b uniform pi=1; arch_b estimated pi.
repro5_EXP-AB-C2B.hypothesis: On 5 fresh seeds the shift-aware precision variant still fails the revival rule, replicating the C2B KILL.
repro5_EXP-AB-C2B.metric: Identical to C2B: mean_return seed-meaned; per-seed revival = (shift: shift_reset >= estimated − 1e-9 AND shift_reset > uniform + 1e-9) AND (stationary: shift_reset >= uniform − 1e-9).
repro5_EXP-AB-C2B.null: Uniform >= shift-reset on both tasks — the precision idea is dead even in shift-aware form (this IS the recorded verdict; the null is the hypothesis here).
repro5_EXP-AB-C2B.pass_fail: KILL REPLICATES iff per-seed revival fails on >= 4/5 seeds (revival holds on <= 1/5). Revival holds on >= 4/5 -> precision REVIVED (rejection overturned — the kill was seed-fragile).
repro5_EXP-AB-C2B.procedure: Identical to C2B: shift arm 10 episodes changing_rule (1 flip); stationary arm 5 episodes phase-0 (10% noise); affect='none'; paired seeds; reset-count diagnostic recorded.
repro5_EXP-AB-C2B.recorded_verdict: KILL: shift_reset 23.97 < estimated 24.10 < uniform 28.47 (shift arm); 24.40 < 34.00 (stationary). Revival failed; shift-aware precision joins the rejected list.

repro5_EXP-AB-C4B.ablation: The action policy (active_inference vs greedy vs random).
repro5_EXP-AB-C4B.baseline: arch_b action_mode greedy / random (identical init across modes).
repro5_EXP-AB-C4B.hypothesis: On 5 fresh seeds AI still fails to beat greedy/random on the probe-error uncertainty-reduction metric, replicating the permanent C4B kill.
repro5_EXP-AB-C4B.metric: Identical to C4B: IG_probe = mean|e0| on the FIXED 400-transition probe before − after 15-episode pomaze training; per-seed kill-holds = AI IG_probe <= max(greedy, random) + 1e-9.
repro5_EXP-AB-C4B.null: AI probe-error reduction <= greedy/random — the IG term is not causal; the 'active inference' label stays off permanently (this IS the recorded verdict).
repro5_EXP-AB-C4B.pass_fail: KILL REPLICATES iff per-seed kill-holds on >= 4/5 seeds. AI beats greedy AND random on >= 4/5 -> kill OVERTURNED (re-opens with caveats).
repro5_EXP-AB-C4B.procedure: Identical to C4B: probe 400 transitions from random-policy pomaze rollouts (fixed seeds 42/901, policy-independent); per (seed, mode) fresh agent with identical init across modes; eval_transition probe; affect='none'.
repro5_EXP-AB-C4B.recorded_verdict: KILL CONFIRMED PERMANENTLY: AI IG_probe 0.5443 < greedy 0.7124 ≈ random 0.5497. Label stays off.

repro5_EXP-AB-K3B.ablation: L1 top-down path (lesion_l1) — same lesion as K3/K3B.
repro5_EXP-AB-K3B.hypothesis: On 5 fresh seeds the arm-A lesion gaps still grow beyond K3's +0.0032 scale, replicating the K3B hierarchy signal.
repro5_EXP-AB-K3B.metric: Identical to K3B: per-seed grown = (delta_e0 > 0.0032 + 1e-9) OR (delta_rerr > 0.0032 + 1e-9) on arm A (changing_rule, 1500 train / 200 held-out). Arm B recorded descriptively.
repro5_EXP-AB-K3B.null: Gaps stay tiny/absent — the hierarchy effect is bounded at K3's weak level.
repro5_EXP-AB-K3B.pass_fail: REPRODUCES iff per-seed grown holds on >= 4/5 seeds. < 4/5 -> hierarchy signal FRAGILE on longer horizons (bound tightened). Gaps at/below K3 scale on >= 4/5 -> effect stays weak / OVERTURNED.
repro5_EXP-AB-K3B.procedure: Identical to K3B: open-loop learn_transition training (no retrieval correction/affect); arm A changing_rule 45 episodes (train first 1500, held-out 1600-1800); arm B delayed_reward 60 episodes (train first 600, held-out last 120); identical init seeds within seed; terminal |rerr| flagged by reward >= 0.5.
repro5_EXP-AB-K3B.recorded_verdict: SURVIVES, STRENGTHENED: arm-A reward-channel gap +0.0602 (3/3 seeds, ~19× K3's +0.0032); arm-A |e0| gap +0.0054 (1/3 reversed, seed-unstable); arm-B |e0| gap +0.0437 (3/3).

repro5_EXP-AB-M1.hypothesis: On 5 fresh seeds, disabling episodic memory selectively degrades pomaze vs delayed_reward, replicating EXP-AB-M1.
repro5_EXP-AB-M1.metric: Identical to M1: mean_return per task; per-seed delta = intact − no_memory; per-seed selective = (delta_pom > 0) AND (delta_pom > delta_drw + 1e-9).
repro5_EXP-AB-M1.null: Seed-mean deltas ≈ 0 on both tasks — the EpisodicStore is decorative in B (NR-B-007).
repro5_EXP-AB-M1.pass_fail: REPRODUCES iff per-seed selective deficit holds on >= 4/5 seeds. Seed-mean deltas ≈ 0 on both tasks -> DECORATIVE (memory demoted to EXECUTED). Mixed (< 4/5, > 0/5 selective) -> FRAGILE.
repro5_EXP-AB-M1.procedure: Identical to M1: pomaze 15 episodes, delayed_reward 10 episodes, affect='none', action_mode='active_inference', paired primary seeds.
repro5_EXP-AB-M1.recorded_verdict: SELECTIVE DEFICIT: pomaze seed-mean delta +2.200 (3/3 seeds +1.83...+2.39) vs delayed_reward +0.046. EpisodicStore CAUSAL on the partial-observability task.

instrument: VERBATIM reuse of prototypes/architecture-b/experiments_phase4.py (exp_m1, exp_c2b, exp_c4b, exp_k3b). No redefinition, no parameter changes, no logic changes. The ONLY change is the seed-list parameter (3 original fresh seeds -> 5 NEW fresh seeds) and the receipt ID (repro5_EXP-AB-* so original receipts are byte-untouched). Driver: prototypes/architecture-b/repro_phase4_5seed.py (additive; patches only the seed list and receipt-ID mapping in module namespace, restores after each run).
replication_rule: Verdict REPRODUCES (or KILL REPLICATES) iff the original verdict's per-seed decision holds on >= 4/5 fresh seeds. The per-seed decision is the original experiment's own decision rule evaluated per seed, frozen below. < 4/5 -> verdict does NOT replicate (FRAGILE if 3/5, OVERTURNED if <= 2/5).
